PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='catboost', seasonality_champion='DWT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: Analysis shows catboost and rf both achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), with catboost selected for superior RMSE (9.63 vs 10.47). DWT_rf leads seasonality capture (0.259 correlation) but has poor overall RMSE (13.50). ETS dominates overall accuracy (9.37 RMSE) and excels at early horizons (4.06 RMSE), while catboost specializes in late horizons (8.48 RMSE). The series exhibits high unpredictability (spectral entropy 0.86) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.09), warranting robust median/trimmed-mean combination over weighted stacking.
